subject: Life Skills
title: Digital Detox Strategies
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Digital Detox Strategies.

hook.text: A study found that a full weekend without phones reduced stress hormones by 25% in participants.

buildup.text: Complete disconnection sounds radical, but even small breaks have measurable cognitive benefits.

discovery.text: A digital detox isn't about quitting technology. It's about reclaiming intentional use over habit.

twist.text: Going cold turkey often fails. Gradual changes like phone-free meals build lasting habits better.

climax.text: Start with one phone-free hour daily. Expand it slowly as the anxiety of missing out fades away.

punchline.text: Boredom is not the enemy. It's the reset button.

quiz.question: What is the most effective way to start a digital detox?
options: Delete all social media accounts immediately
Start with small phone-free periods daily
Only use your phone for emergencies
